Spring Framework 6.2.19. No bump possible: every fix for the 6.2.x line (6.2.20) is Enterprise Support Only and is not published to Maven Central; the OSS fix is 7.0.9, which requires Spring Boot 4.x. Boot 3.5.16 (current, latest 3.5.x) pins 6.2.19. None of the four are reachable in PCS: CVE-2026-47893 - WebFlux WebSocket exception reason. spring-webflux is test-only, not on runtimeClasspath; PCS has no WebSocket endpoints. CVE-2026-47892 - WebFlux functional endpoints deployed with DispatcherServlet. PCS is WebMVC with annotated controllers only; no RouterFunctions. CVE-2026-59283 - SpEL SimpleEvaluationContext guard bypass with the SpEL compiler active. PCS evaluates no SpEL and does not enable the compiler. CVE-2026-59280 - FreeMarker path traversal via SpringTemplateLoader. FreeMarker is not on any classpath (PCS templating is Pebble); no view name is derived from untrusted input. Remove once the CCD SDK / Boot BOM moves PCS onto a Spring Framework 7.x line.

CVE-2026-59270: Spring Security 6.5.11 embedded UnboundID LDAP server (UnboundIdContainer) registers an admin credential and binds to all interfaces. No bump possible: the 6.5.x fix (6.5.12) is Enterprise Support Only and is not on Maven Central; the OSS fixes (7.0.7 / 7.1.1) require Spring Boot 4.x. Boot 3.5.16 pins 6.5.11. Not reachable: PCS does not use LDAP at all - neither spring-security-ldap nor unboundid-ldapsdk is on runtimeClasspath, and no spring.ldap.embedded.* properties are set, so UnboundIdContainer is never instantiated. Remove once PCS moves onto a Spring Security 7.x line.

CVE-2026-59284: Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.3 has no allow list for property keys when the writable /actuator/env endpoint is enabled. No bump possible: the 4.3.x fix (4.3.4) is Enterprise Support Only and is not on Maven Central; the OSS fix is 5.0.3, which requires Spring Boot 4.x. 4.3.3 arrives transitively via spring-cloud-dependencies 2025.0.0 / core-case-data-store-client. Not reachable: the writable env endpoint is opt-in and PCS does not enable it - application.yaml exposes only health, info and prometheus over the web. The pattern covers every spring-cloud-* artifact on the 4.3.x line, not just spring-cloud-commons: dependency-check assigns the broadcom:spring_cloud_commons CPE to sibling jars too, and reported this CVE against spring-cloud-starter@4.3.3. Remove once PCS moves onto a Spring Cloud 2026.x / Commons 5.x line.

Spring Framework 6.2.19. No bump possible: the 6.2.x fix (6.2.20) is Enterprise Support Only and is not published to Maven Central; the OSS fix is 7.0.8.1, which requires Spring Boot 4.x. Boot 3.5.16 (current, latest 3.5.x) pins 6.2.19 - the same position as the CVE-2026-47893 group above. None of the four are reachable in PCS: CVE-2026-47890 - SSE stream corruption with view fragments. PCS declares no Server-Sent Events endpoints (no SseEmitter, ServerSentEvent or text/event-stream producer anywhere in src/main) and has no view layer to emit fragments from. CVE-2026-47891 - WebFlux maxInMemorySize bypass via the Aalto XML processor. spring-boot-starter-webflux is testImplementation only (build.gradle:482), so spring-webflux is not on runtimeClasspath, and Aalto is not on any classpath. CVE-2026-59281 - reflected XSS via the no-argument Errors.getFieldErrors() / getFieldError() accessors rendered into an HTML view. PCS calls neither accessor, is @RestController-only (its four @Controller* matches are all @ControllerAdvice exception handlers), and renders no HTML views. CVE-2026-59282 - DoS when user-supplied property paths are applied through the data-binding infrastructure. PCS uses no DataBinder, @InitBinder, @ModelAttribute or BeanWrapper; request bodies are deserialised straight to DTOs by Jackson, which is not the affected path. Remove once the CCD SDK / Boot BOM moves PCS onto a Spring Framework 7.x line.

CVE-2026-59276: Spring Security 6.5.11 compares some security-sensitive values with String.equals() rather than a constant-time comparison, allowing a timing side channel. No bump possible: the 6.5.x fix (6.5.12) is Enterprise Support Only and is not on Maven Central; the OSS fixes (7.0.6.1 / 7.1.0.1) require Spring Boot 4.x. Boot 3.5.16 pins 6.5.11 - the same position as CVE-2026-59270 above. Low exploitability here: the affected comparisons sit in features PCS does not use to authenticate callers. PCS delegates all authentication to IDAM (OAuth2 resource server with JWT, verified via spring-security-oauth2-jose) and S2S; it issues no remember-me tokens, no password-reset or one-time tokens, and stores no passwords, so there is no PCS-controlled secret being compared. Scored 5.9 MEDIUM (AC:H) upstream. Remove once PCS moves onto a Spring Security 7.x line.
